Initial release of phy-openapi-sec-audit — an OpenAPI/Swagger security auditor.

- Scans OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.0 specs (YAML or JSON) for 10 critical API security misconfigurations.
- Detects issues including missing authentication, plaintext HTTP, API keys in query strings, deprecated OAuth flows, sensitive fields in responses, missing input validation, unprotected admin endpoints, file upload DoS risks, wildcard OAuth scopes, and missing 401/403 responses.
- Supports scanning local files, entire directories, or URLs.
- Designed for CI integration and can fail builds on CRITICAL/HIGH findings.
- Zero external dependencies (only requires PyYAML for YAML support).
